sam: Quick repro for a bundler/edge issue with the JS SDK. Happening when bundling for an edge runtime (vite + worker adapter). Error shown below and a tiny repro steps list.

marina: can you paste the stack? also which sdk package name?

sam: package is `redwood-inference-js` (local SDK bundle). Stack:
```
TypeError: (0 , _interopDefault.default) is not a function
    at init_runtime (node_modules/redwood-inference-js/dist/index.mjs:12:45)
    at file:///app/.netlify/functions/edge-handler.js:23:5
    at async handleRequest (edge-runtime:12345)
```

sam: Repro steps (minimal):
1) `npm init -y && npm i vite@4 @vercel/edge-runtime redwood-inference-js`
2) create `index.js`:
```js
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference-js';
export default function onRequest() {
  const c = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RI_KEY });
  return new Response('ok');
}
```
3) `vite build --ssr` then deploy to edge adapter (or run the edge runtime locally).

sam: Observed behavior: build succeeds but at runtime the edge bundle throws that interop TypeError. Works fine in node SSR.

marina: I can repro on Vite 4 + @vercel/edge-runtime. Looks like the SDK's published `exports` map points to `.mjs` that still contains mixed CJS-style interop which some bundlers transform incorrectly.

marina: Quick workaround that made it work for me: in `vite.config.js` add:
```js
export default {
  build: { ssr: true },
  ssr: {
    noExternal: ['redwood-inference-js']
  },
  optimizeDeps: {
    include: ['redwood-inference-js']
  }
}
```

tj: FWIW on Rollup/webpack we had to force-transpile the SDK because it ships a mix of `require()` and ESM. Example webpack rule: `test: /redwood-inference-js/, use: { loader: 'babel-loader', options: { presets: ['@babel/preset-env'] } }` — not great but works.

ash: (ping) this seems like a packaging/exports bug rather than Vite specifically. SDK should provide a clean ESM entry for edge runtimes.

ash: Proposed packaging changes: add explicit `exports` entries: `{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","default":"./dist/index.cjs"}` and ensure the mjs build doesn't include CommonJS interop calls.

ash: Also add a devex doc showing `vite.config` workarounds and a tiny repro repo (1 file + package.json) to reproduce quickly.

ash: cc @dev-bot to link CI that failed on a sample app earlier.

dev-bot: CI: sample-app-edge-vite failed on build 2276543220. Logs uploaded: https://ci.example/2276543220/logs

tj: Another note: `ssr.noExternal` helps but increases bundle size because it forces bundlers to process node_modules. For customers on constrained edge limits, we should upstream a proper ESM-only build.

ash: Agreed. I'll open an SDK PR to: (1) publish a purified ESM entry, (2) update `package.json` exports map, (3) add a `DX` doc with repro + `vite.config` and webpack/Babel sample.

marina: Also adding a typed example for TS users: import types from `redwood-inference-js/types` and ensure `types` field in package.json points to `dist/index.d.ts`. That avoids weird `any` typing when transpiling.

sam: Thanks — I'll drop a tiny repro repo (single-file) and link the PR after I confirm the workarounds. For now adding the `ssr.noExternal` note to our docs would help a bunch. :thumbsup:

ash: filing tracking issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/164 (will update with repro).

sam: cool, marking this resolved for now with workaround. I'll follow up with the PR/issue links in this thread.
